_comment: Reprise (CR 8.4.3) is an EXISTING condition backed by combat.defender_used_hand_card — the card invented DEFENDED_WITH_HAND_CARD instead. The reprise half was also ability_type STATIC on an Attack Reaction card, so it could not have fired even with the flag set. 'Weapons you control gain +1{p} until end of turn' is MODIFY_ATTACKS_THIS_TURN filtered to weapon attacks, not a MODIFY_ATTACK on the current attack. "Target WEAPON attack" -- the ability had no target filter at all, so it pumped ANY attack, not just a weapon attack. Found by sweeping cards whose text says "target weapon attack" for an ability with effects and no weapon filter.
